boundary: Information Quality would fit only if the action corrupted or falsified information rather than deleting user-owned content and removing apps that were opened within the last day.
factor: removal of actively used apps and loss of locally held user content
note: The assessor never stated that QQ and WeChat were last opened on 16-17 Mar, so it missed that uninstalling them disrupts services the user relies on, and it framed loss of the draft recordings as an information-quality harm (and added Privacy, though nothing leaves the device). Taking the recent-use fact into account gives gold Operational / Service + Financial / Assets (lost user assets).
